mapper.select: SELECT EGLSM.PROC_DATE ,EGLSM.LINK_ID ,EGLSM.SPD ,EGLSM.VOL ,EGLSM.DENS ,EGLSM.TRVL_TIME ,EGLSM.LINK_DELAYTIME ,EGLSM.Q_LEN ,EGLSM.OCC ,EGLSM.CONG_GRADE ,EGLSM.DOW_CD ,EGLSM.WEATH_INFL_CD ,EGLSM.TFINFO_CRE_TP_CD ,EGLSM.RECURRENT_YN ,EGLSM.ORG_CODE ,EGLSM.COLL_DATE FROM BIGDATA.EXT_GGITS_LINK_STD_1M EGLSM INNER JOIN ( SELECT MAX(EGLSM.PROC_DATE) AS RCT_CLCT_DT ,EGLSM.LINK_ID FROM BIGDATA.EXT_GGITS_LINK_STD_1M EGLSM GROUP BY EGLSM.LINK_ID ) RCT ON RCT.LINK_ID = EGLSM.LINK_ID AND RCT.RCT_CLCT_DT = EGLSM.PROC_DATE
